verdict.rationale: The docs say customers can configure the equation that calculates their risk score and that AML screening runs based on that underlying risk score. That is a thin, product-native form of tuning risk scoring and routing by score. Nothing documents mapping score ranges to explicit allow, review, block or step-up 3DS actions, and the case decisions in docs-9 are manual analyst dispositions, not score-driven rules. Missing for 10: configurable score-range thresholds, mapping ranges to allow/review/block actions, step-up 3DS action, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
